meta.what: The project's word types, under the ruling recorded as proposal 7 in docs/decisions-log.md.
meta.credit: The classification is Thuum.org's, from its Fifth Edition dictionary (non-commercial use; see research/sources/thuum/ATTRIBUTION.md). The dictionary calls it unofficial.
ruling: The Fifth Edition's types are the starting types.
A word may be used in every role the system allows, whether or not the game shows that use.
Uses attested in game text are information, not a limit.
In the forge a new verb or adjective is strong unless a separate noun for the same idea exists.

fields.class: noun, verb, adjective, pronoun, adverb, conjunction, preposition, article, interjection or prefix
fields.can_also_be_a_noun: true for a strong verb or adjective, false for a weak one, null where the dictionary does not say or the question does not arise
fields.roles_the_dictionary_lists: the parts of speech named in the entry's expanded definition
fields.roles_allowed: the class, plus noun if strong, plus adverb for an adjective, plus every role the dictionary lists
fields.roles_attested_in_game_text: to be filled when the sentence checker is built

meta.words_with_no_type_yet_note: Vocabulary the Fifth Edition does not cover. The project assigns these types.

words.meaning: A/An (Song of the Dragonborn, not generally used)
Wound (as in, injury/hurt/etc. - noun or verb)
And (formal - not commonly used) (Dragon Language: Myth No More)
Of/About, often unused in sentence formation
Dragon/Dragonkind/Wyrm (referring to the race of dragons)
Dragon (also means “me” when a dragon speaks)
Her (used equally with the “ii” form of the possessive)
The (rare, only used with specific proper nouns or as a sign of reverence, as in “Faal Krein - The Sun”)
The (not commonly used in regular sentence structure)
Elder Scroll (abbreviated to “Scroll” in the Song of the Dragonborn)
World (equivalent to Mundus - the universe, everything)
Is/Was (Combine with other verbs to form present tense: “is helping”, “Is sworn”)
Throat of the World = Mother (of the) Wind
Fierce (“Fiercest” in the Song of the Dragonborn)
Rul (special case, used only when the word is the first in the sentence)
Of, should be used when new words are formed
Sun (Word of Power, see also Krein)
Breath/inner spirit (used in terms of the Voice power)
Our (possessive form of we - not commonly used)
Un- (prefix meaning “opposite of”, e.g. unkind, unlikeable, etc.)
Do not wait / Do not delay
With (Song of the Dragonborn - avoid using)
Shout (noun) (meaning yell, not use of Voice power)

words.note: printed as a verb in the copy; the entry itself defines a pronoun

words.meaning: Voice (the actual mortal voice, not the power of the shouting [sic])
